description: This file contains unit tests for the HL7Service component in the OpenMRS project. It tests parsing and processing of HL7 messages, resolution of person and location identifiers, and user identification logic, ensuring proper handling of various scenarios including valid, invalid, and ambiguous data.

classes.name: HL7ServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for HL7Service, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to provide an environment for testing HL7 message processing, person/location/user resolution, and message parsing.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue_shouldAddGeneratedUuidIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Tests that saving an HL7InQueue without a UUID assigns a new UUID.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldCreateHL7InArchiveAfterSuccessfulParsing
methods.description: Verifies that processing a queue item creates an archive entry if parsing succeeds.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldCreateHL7InErrorAfterFailedParsing
methods.description: Ensures that a failed message parsing results in an error record.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldFailIfGivenInQueueIsAlreadyMarkedAsProcessing
methods.description: Checks that processing an already processing message throws an HL7Exception.

methods.name: processHL7Message_shouldSaveHl7MessageToTheDatabase
methods.description: Validates that processing an HL7 message saves the message and creates observations in the database.

methods.name: parseHL7String_shouldParseTheGivenStringIntoMessage
methods.description: Tests parsing of a raw HL7 string into a Message object.

methods.name: processHL7Message_shouldParseMessageTypeSuppliedByModule
methods.description: Disabled test for processing messages with custom module-specified handlers.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldParseOruR01MessageUsingOverriddenParserProvidedByAModule
methods.description: Disabled test for processing ORU R01 messages with module-provided handlers.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAPersonBasedOnAPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Checks resolving a person using patient identifiers.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAPersonBasedOnAUUID
methods.description: Checks resolving a person based on a UUID identifier.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAPersonBasedOnTheInternalPersonID
methods.description: Verifies resolving a person using internal ID from NK1 segment.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldReturnNullIfNoPersonIsFound
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when no matching person is found.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailIfAPersonWithTheSameUUIDExists
methods.description: Tests exception thrown when a person with the same UUID already exists.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailIfNoBirthdateSpecified
methods.description: Checks that missing birthdate in NK1 causes failure.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailIfNoGenderSpecified
methods.description: Checks that missing gender causes failure.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailOnAnInvalidGender
methods.description: Tests failure for invalid gender value.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldReturnASavedNewPerson
methods.description: Verifies creation and saving of new person from NK1 data.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldReturnAPatientIfValidPatientIdentifiersExist
methods.description: Checks that valid patient identifiers lead to an existing Patient object.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAUUIDInAnyPositionOfTheArray
methods.description: Tests UUID extraction when UUID appears in various positions in identifiers array.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldReturnNullIfNoUUIDFound
methods.description: Verifies null return when no UUID present.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldNotFailIfMultipleSimilarUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Checks that multiple similar UUIDs do not cause failure.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldFailIfMultipleDifferentUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures failure when multiple different UUIDs are found within identifiers.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldFailIfMultipleDifferentUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Verifies exception when conflicting UUIDs are present.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldNotFailIfMultipleSimilarUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Confirms that similar UUIDs do not cause failure.

methods.name: resolveLocationId_shouldReturnInternalIdentifierOfLocationIfOnlyLocationNameIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests resolving location based on location name only.

methods.name: resolveLocationId_shouldReturnInternalIdentifierOfLocationIfOnlyLocationIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests resolving location based on location id only.

methods.name: resolveLocationId_shouldReturnNullIfLocationIdAndNameAreIncorrect
methods.description: Verifies null return for invalid location data.

methods.name: resolveUserId_shouldReturnNullForAmbiguousUsersUsingFirstAndLastNameGivenUserIDIsNull
methods.description: Checks that ambiguous user resolution returns null.

methods.name: resolveUserId_shouldReturnUserUsingFirstAndLastNameGivenUserIDIsNull
methods.description: Validates user resolution by first and last name.

methods.name: resolveUserId_shouldReturnUserUsingUsername
methods.description: Verifies user resolution via username when userID is null.
